experiment_data.hypothesis: ActAdd inference-time activation steering can reduce sycophantic flip behavior by adding contrastive direction vectors at inference time, increasing NoF rate without retraining the model
experiment_data.failure_reason: All alpha values (0.0-5.0) produce identical NoF=0.696, WRR=0.271. Steering hooks did not take effect during generation — likely KV cache bypass or hook registration issue.

spec.notes: Re-run v2 after hook fix. Root cause: transformers 4.57 Qwen3DecoderLayer.forward() returns raw tensor not tuple. Old hook did output[0] which indexed batch dim, then seq_len check always failed → hooks never modified anything. Fix: isinstance(output, torch.Tensor) check, handle both tensor and tuple output formats.

metrics.note: non-monotonic: alpha 0.5/2.0 similar to baseline, only alpha 5.0 shows clear improvement
